items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide, with conditional approval for the bounded stinkyleftfoot.com SEO change. Severity is high for security-sensitive releases and new public exposure because fleet-doctor has no run or checks, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, dependency provenance, release controls, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced across the fleet. No credential exposure, exploit, or security incident is evidenced; absence of telemetry is not clearance. Exact decision: approve only the existing single-page SEO change because it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, configuration, tracking, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Require build, diff-scope, canonical, robots, sitemap, link, disclosure, and indexability checks plus isolated rollback. Retain private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; do not treat this as fleet security clearance or certification.
